content.short: Areon Network provides the world's first Proof of Area blockchain ecosystem.
content.description: Areon Network presents Areon Chain, a decentralized layer-1 blockchain designed for stable development. It relies on the Proof of Area consensus to deliver fast, low-cost transactions and smooth dApp creation. The network supports up to 600,000 TPS, with validator and delegator participation to strengthen security and community involvement. Powered by the $AREA token and complemented by AreonAI, AreonScan, and AreonWallet, Areon Chain broadens usability and supports a wide range of applications.
content.meta: Areon Network presents Areon Chain, a decentralized layer 1 blockchain with Proof of Area. Discover Areon Network and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
